title: MOXIR v2.11 — the patch by kind: U1 the beams, U2 the washes, the two 40 W lasers and the haze
howToRead: docs/architecture/RIG_BUILD.md §19. Owner 2026-10-15 22:2x: 'with the patching let's in one universe make the beam, the other the washes and the lasers.' Apply: patch-plan.mjs --plan <this> --keep-circuits; then patch.mjs --project moxir-v2-11 --exact; then patch-sheet.mjs. Never edit addresses by hand.
method: One universe per KIND of lamp, not per cable run: U1 = the 18 UP-B380F beams; U2 = the 40 UP-PL5403 washes, the two UP-LA40WF 40 W lasers and the UP-YZ31P haze (the owner's word, 2026-10-15). Placement is the owner's and does not change an address: a lamp keeps its address when it is moved.
Blocks start on round numbers (001, 401, 501) and the fixture number says the universe and the block (hundreds = universe, tens = block).
Within a block lamps go by their unit id (id-asc): rig-beam-planes-01 first. An address stays with its unit when the unit is moved.
The 36 LaserCube lines run over the LAN (fixture.dmx false) and take no address.

node.what: one Art-Net node at the booth; U1 on port A, U2 on port B
node.numbering: desk universe U1 = Art-Net Port-Address 0 = sACN universe 1; U2 = Port-Address 1 = sACN 2

up-b380f.why: the maker's one mode (16 channels); channel order ASSUMED (RIG_BUILD §18.1)

up-pl5403.why: the maker's one mode (8 channels); channel order ASSUMED until the rental unit's chart is read

up-la40wf.why: the chart scripts/place/fixtures/charts/up-la40wf.json (32 channels), as patched 2026-10-15 (U1.401 / U1.433 before this plan)

up-yz31p.why: one channel, ASSUMED (maybe 2) — as patched before this plan

universes.label: The beams
universes.run: node port A → the 18 UP-B380F (plane 1 behind the DJ, the two side lines)

blocks.what: the 18 UP-B380F beams, by unit id

universes.label: The washes, the lasers and the haze
universes.run: node port B → the 40 UP-PL5403, the two UP-LA40WF on the entry wall, the haze behind the booth

blocks.what: the 40 UP-PL5403 washes (the cut, the pars, the lines, the road), by unit id
